"""Retain the executed qualification smoke and scheduler diagnosis, without raw logs."""
from collections import Counter
import hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
import runpy

task=Path(__file__).resolve().parent; repo=task.parents[2]; work=task/'policy-gates'
helper=runpy.run_path(str(task/'retain-gates-qualification-mac.py'))
clean=lambda x: helper['clean'](x,task,repo)
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text())
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
d=work/'qualification-smoke-Linux'; rp=d/'run-0-0/results.json'; sp=d/'summary.json'; result=read(rp); report=read(sp)
assert result['status']=='complete' and not result['failures'] and result['budget_compliant']
calls=[c for cell in result['cases'] for c in cell['warmups']]+[c for cell in result['cases'] for b in cell['blocks'] for c in b['calls']]
assert len(result['cases'])==10 and len(calls)==report['native_calls']==90
assert report['status']=='smoke_complete' and not report['errors']
fields={}
account=d/'8247925.1.txt'
for line in account.read_text().splitlines():
 pair=line.split(None,1)
 if len(pair)==2:
  assert pair[0] not in fields
  fields[pair[0]]=pair[1].strip()
assert fields['jobnumber']=='8247925' and fields['taskid']=='1' and fields['failed'].split()[0]==fields['exit_status']=='0'
completion=d/'fgates_smoke.o8247925.1'
assert 'GATES_LINUX_QUALIFICATION_SMOKE_COMPLETE' in completion.read_text()
obs=d/'run-0-0/host-0/host-observations.jsonl'
events=[json.loads(x) for x in obs.read_text().splitlines()]; process=[e for e in events if e['kind']=='process']
assert not any(e['kind']=='error' or e.get('competing_compute') for e in events)
checks=[]
labels=('gates-qualification-smoke-submit','gates-qualification-smoke-report','gates-qualification-smoke-collect',
        'gates-qualification-linux-submit','gates-qualification-job-bindings','gates-qualification-job-bindings-py36',
        'gates-qualification-job-bindings-normalized','gates-qualification-queued-verification',
        'gates-qualification-queued-full-verification','gates-qualification-capacity-diagnosis','gates-qualification-queue-eligibility')
for label in labels:
 p=task/'setup1-review/checks'/(label+'.json'); r=read(p)
 assert sha(p.with_suffix('.log'))==r['log_sha256']
 checks.append({k:r[k] for k in ('label','command','exit','elapsed_s','log_sha256')})
record=dict(schema=1,date='2026-10-22',purpose='Completed qualification smoke and operational scheduling diagnosis. This is not the final Linux qualification result.',
 freeze=dict(file='two-fe-policy-gates-qualification-freeze-20261022.json',sha256=sha(repo/'bench/results/two-fe-policy-gates-qualification-freeze-20261022.json')),
 smoke=dict(result_sha256=sha(rp),report_sha256=sha(sp),result=result,report=report,
  accounting_sha256=sha(account),accounting={k:fields[k] for k in ('qname','hostname','project','jobname','jobnumber','taskid','qsub_time','start_time','end_time','granted_pe','slots','failed','exit_status','ru_wallclock','cpu','maxvmem')},
  completion_marker='GATES_LINUX_QUALIFICATION_SMOKE_COMPLETE',completion_log_sha256=sha(completion),
  observer=dict(raw_sha256=sha(obs),kinds=dict(Counter(e['kind'] for e in events)),
   max_process_gap_s=max((b['monotonic_ns']-a['monotonic_ns'])/1e9 for a,b in zip(process,process[1:])),
   max_process_capture_s=max((e['finished_monotonic_ns']-e['monotonic_ns'])/1e9 for e in process),
   observed_competing_compute=[],errors=[])),
 submitted=read(work/'qualification-submissions.json'),checks=checks,
 scheduling_diagnosis=dict(
  excluded_host='scc-wp3',rule='guren-queue1_limits',enabled=True,limit='users !guren,!tjmcq hosts scc-wp3.scc.bu.edu to slots=0',
  captured_rule=dict(sha256=sha(work/'qualification-wp3-restriction.txt'),source=(work/'qualification-wp3-restriction.txt').read_text()),
  implication='The original wp3 assignment cannot run for this account. Remaining original w28 assignments were occupied at inspection.',
  verification_limitation='qalter -w p probes printed no-project diagnostics even with a supplied project. They did not alter the actual job, whose welfgr/omp28/28 and full resource request were rechecked. The explicit host-user restriction supplies the diagnosis.',
  capacity_raw_sha256={p.name:sha(p) for p in (work/'host-capacity.xml',work/'queue-capacity.xml',work/'qualification-alternative-pe.txt')},
  alternative='Public u/z queues have idle 28-core capacity but accept different MPI PEs, with allocation_rule 28, MPI start/stop hooks, control_slaves TRUE and job_is_first_task FALSE.',
  boundary='No PE extension, host reassignment or observer relaxation performed. Changing hash-bound scheduler validation requires a prospective execution-contract decision; original evidence remains intact.'),
 failures=[
  dict(action='Job-binding read-only query',cause='SCC Python 3.6 rejected subprocess text=True before querying.',effect='No job or data changed; corrected use of universal_newlines was retained.'),
  dict(action='Job-binding validation',cause='Assumed short hostnames while SGE returned FQDNs.',effect='Normalized read-only validation passed; actual requests already correct.'),
  dict(action='Read-only smoke log parsing',cause='Treated literal smoke_complete report log as JSON.',effect='Read actual summary.json instead; no execution effect.',log_sha256=None),
  dict(action='Read-only capacity parsing',cause='Initial FQDN/short-host join reported zero idle queues.',effect='Corrected join on same captured XML; no scheduler action.',log_sha256=None),
  dict(action='Read-only source and schema discovery',cause='Several guessed helper paths did not exist; smoke schema lacks native_calls_started.',effect='Located actual files and counted all retained calls; no source, evidence or execution change.',log_sha256=None),
  dict(action='Read-only qhost lookup',cause='Unprefixed wp3 did not resolve.',effect='Canonical scc-wp3 query succeeded.',log_sha256=None)],
 metadata_validation_note='An initial read-only partial-result check compared the raw plan file SHA with the runner canonical-JSON identity and failed. Recomputing the documented canonical identity verified all 12 completed task metadata and 2,520 calls; no plan or result was changed.',
 independent_review=dict(smoke_calls_exact=90,reference_heads_rehashed=30,checks_verified=11,
  process_samples=24,censuses=3,reservations=2,accounting_and_completion_verified=True,
  limitation='Local smoke NPZ arrays deliberately omitted from collection; no independent array or oracle verification is claimed.',
  failed_read_only_probe='Optional local NPZ hash check encountered the intentionally absent arrays; available result/report/head/observer/accounting evidence was then checked.',
  resolved_retention_gap='Exact qconf host-user restriction was recaptured and hash-bound after reviewer noted it was previously only asserted metadata.'),
 limitations=['Smoke covers ten cells and one host; it establishes deployment/science execution only. All smoke performance bounds remain inconclusive.',
  'Host observation is sampled. No final Linux qualification or public activation follows from this record.',
  'Raw logs and numerical arrays are not embedded. The smoke call objects, fingerprints, trace summaries and artifact/input/source identities are retained here.'])
record['retention_tool']={'sha256':sha(Path(__file__)),'source':Path(__file__).read_text()}
text=json.dumps(clean(record),sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False)+'\n'
assert len(text.encode())<1000000
assert not any('/'+x in text for x in ('Users/','projectnb/','usr4/','usr2/'))
assert 'target/'+'tmp/' not in text
out=repo/'bench/results/two-fe-policy-gates-qualification-operations-20261022.json'
if out.exists():
 assert read(out)['smoke']['result']==clean(result), 'refusing to change smoke observations'
out.write_text(text)
r=read(out);assert r['smoke']['result']==clean(result)
print(out.name,len(text.encode()),sha(out),'all90calls_retained')
